---
title: Course FAQ
description: What is available, what you need, and what progress means.
---

## Is the complete course available?

No. The curriculum is in development. The [course map](../courses/agentic-ai-engineering/index.qmd)
labels the 101 lessons and 25 challenges as planned. The smoke lab and unit outlines
are useful preparation, not substitutes for the future lessons.

## Do I need to know Python?

Yes: project-ready Python or equivalent readiness. Check functions, collections,
modules, exceptions, virtual environments, and tests in the
[readiness guide](../courses/agentic-ai-engineering/readiness.qmd).
This course does not re-teach beginner Python as an agent curriculum.

## Must I buy API credits or have a GPU?

No paid service is required for the core route. The current smoke lab uses a
standard-library fake model, without inference or network calls. Later lessons will
provide deterministic fixtures alongside documented open-model/free execution paths.
Optional provider comparisons must disclose costs and keep keys out of artifacts.

## How do the notebooks work?

The website's QMD pages are canonical. The build exports notebook copies to the
published site; Colab links work after that branch is deployed. Overview notebooks
contain orientation only. The smoke notebook bundles the small course package so its
Python examples can execute offline without installing a package from a registry.

## Is browser completion a qualification?

No. It is a local convenience, not verified assessment, identity, or certification.
It does not sync between devices and can disappear when storage is cleared.
Completion controls remain disabled for planned material. No certificate is offered.

## Where should I report a problem?

Use the [repository issue tracker](https://github.com/freecampus/agentic-ai-engineering/issues).
Include the page, environment, smallest reproduction, expected and actual behavior,
and a redacted trace. Never include provider keys, personal data, or private prompts.
